findings.pool_thread_stall_fixed: single process at 64 users: 4-6 rps, p95 >10 s, 503s before; ~70 rps, no stall after admission control

environment: shared 12-core developer laptop, load average up to 52; client, API, PostgreSQL and OCR on one host
limitations: Not production capacity; Phase 19 must re-measure on target sizes.
No soak test; status polls still write one audit row each.
Face/liveness/NFC/webhook/review endpoints not load-tested over HTTP.
Document processing holds one transaction during OCR.
Admission control and rate limits are per process.
